title: AlgebraicAnalysis: reusable Lean foundations for algebraic analysis
description: Reusable Lean 4 definitions and proofs for derivation-Ore extensions, differential operators, filtered modules, localization, rank and length arguments. Includes finite-order coordinate generation and regular-action faithfulness. Application-specific Stafford assembly remains downstream. Pins Lean v4.33.0 and official Mathlib v4.33.0.
